summary_en: This phase 1 study tests an investigational dendritic cell vaccine, primed with HER2 or HER3, in people with early-stage triple negative breast cancer or HR-low positive breast cancer. Participants receive 8 ultrasound-guided injections into the tumor, given twice per week and alternating HER2-primed and HER3-primed cells, together with standard of care chemotherapy drugs. The study measures the maximum tolerated dose (MTD) of the vaccine.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 evalúa una vacuna experimental de células dendríticas, activadas con HER2 o HER3, en personas con cáncer de mama triple negativo en etapa temprana o cáncer de mama con bajo nivel de receptores hormonales positivo. Los participantes reciben 8 inyecciones en el tumor guiadas por ultrasonido, dos veces por semana, alternando células activadas con HER2 y células activadas con HER3, junto con medicamentos de quimioterapia estándar. El estudio mide la dosis máxima tolerada (MTD) de la vacuna.
who_for: Tumor is HR-negative or HR-low positive
Early-stage tumor size and lymph node criteria as stated in the record
Medically and surgically able to receive neoadjuvant chemotherapy followed by standard local therapy
Age 18 or older with ECOG performance status 0 or 1
not_for: Prior anthracycline-based chemotherapy for any cancer
Active autoimmune disease, or chronic systemic corticosteroid use of one month or more
History of HIV, or hepatitis B or C infection
Prior treatment with any HER2- or HER3-primed dendritic cell therapy
